requirements and company procedures.

"## Structural Engineer

## Position Overview

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Structural Engineer to join our team and contribute to the design, analysis, and delivery of a diverse range of construction and infrastructure projects. The ideal candidate will bring strong technical expertise, a commitment to structural integrity, and the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams. This role suits an experienced engineer who thrives in a dynamic environment and is passionate about delivering safe, innovative, and cost-effective structural solutions.

## Key Responsibilities

- Analyse structural systems for both static and dynamic loading conditions, ensuring all designs meet relevant Australian standards and codes of practice
- Determine appropriate construction methods, materials, and quality standards, and develop detailed specifications, drawings, and construction procedures to guide project delivery
- Design structures across a range of typologies to ensure they perform safely and do not collapse, deflect excessively, or behave in any undesirable manner under load
- Prepare and review engineering drawings, reports, and documentation in support of development approvals, construction certificates, and project handover
- Conduct site inspections and supervise construction activities to verify works are being carried out in accordance with approved designs and specifications
- Assess and evaluate the behaviour and durability of construction materials, recommending suitable options based on project requirements and site conditions
- Collaborate with architects, civil engineers, project managers, and other stakeholders to develop integrated structural solutions from concept through to completion
- Identify and manage structural risks throughout the project lifecycle, providing practical engineering solutions to resolve design and construction challenges
- Prepare and review structural calculations, geotechnical reports, and material testing data to inform and validate design decisions
- Contribute to the mentoring and technical development of graduate and junior engineers within the team
- Liaise with clients, contractors, and regulatory authorities to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards

## Required Qualifications & Skills

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Structural Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related discipline
- Registered or eligible for registration as a Professional Engineer in the relevant Australian state or territory
- Demonstrated experience in structural engineering design across commercial, residential, or infrastructure projects
- Proficiency in structural analysis and modelling software such as ETABS, SAP2000, SPACE GASS, Strand7, or similar
- Sound knowledge of Australian Standards and the National Construction Code (NCC)
- Strong ability to prepare, interpret, and review engineering drawings, specifications, and technical reports
- Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to deliver practical and innovative structural solutions
- Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage confidently with clients, contractors, and multidisciplinary teams
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously
- Full working rights in Australia

## Preferred Qualifications

- Membership with Engineers Australia (MIEAust) or Chartered Professional Engineer (CPEng) status, or working towards chartership
- Experience with Building Information Modelling (BIM) platforms such as Revit Structure
- Familiarity with sustainable design principles and experience delivering projects with a focus on environmental performance
- Postgraduate qualifications or specialist training in structural or geotechnical engineering
- Experience working on mixed-use, high-rise, or large-scale infrastructure projects
- Exposure to project management frameworks and familiarity with construction contract administration

## Why Join Us?

- Work on a varied and challenging portfolio of projects spanning commercial, residential, and infrastructure sectors, with genuine opportunities to advance your career
- Flexible working arrangements available, including hybrid options, to support a healthy work-life balance
- Ongoing investment in your professional development, including support for CPEng chartership, training programmes, and industry memberships
- Be part of a collaborative, inclusive team culture that values innovation, technical excellence, and mutual respect
- Competitive remuneration package with annual salary reviews and access to performance-based incentives

## Job Details

- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation"

Seven Corp on behalf of Adelaide Steel Frame Windows

Overview: 

Adelaide Steel Frame Windows is South Australia’s largest manufacturer of architectural steel doors and windows. Operating successfully for over 24 years, our continued growth has led to a recent expansion into a larger facility in Regency Park. We take immense pride in our craftsmanship, solid work ethic, and supportive team culture.

We are seeking a dedicated, full-time Metal Machinist / CNC Specialist to join our production team. In this role, your primary responsibility will be setting up, programming, and operating precision tools and machinery to shape high-tolerance steel components for our bespoke architectural doors and windows.

This position is ideal for a precision-focused tradesperson with comprehensive experience in both complex manual milling and turning operations alongside advanced CNC programming. Working alongside our workshop floor team, you will enhance productivity, ensure strict quality control, troubleshoot manufacturing challenges, and assist in mentoring apprentice team members.

Main Tasks:

-	Interpret complex technical drawings, blueprints, and engineering specifications to determine job requirements, tooling needs, and sequence of machining operations.
-	 Set up, program, and operate a variety of machine tools including CNC processing machines, lathes, milling machines, and precision grinders to shape steel components.
-	Calculate engineering parameters, feed rates, and cutting speeds; check fabricated components for conformity and extreme precision using micrometers, calipers, and gauges.
-	Embrace daily tradesperson challenges to diagnose, troubleshoot, and enhance overall machining and manufacturing processes.
-	Work closely alongside the workshop floor team to achieve optimal assembly timeframes, minimise material wastage, and maintain high-quality project outcomes.


Required/Relevant Qualifications & Work Experience:

-	Minimum AQF Certificate III in Engineering - Mechanical Trade (Machining)
-	A minimum of one year of full-time proven professional experience setting up, programming, and operating both CNC and manual metalworking machinery, or
-	At least 3 years of relevant experience as a Metal Machinist to substitute the formal qualification.
-	Forklift license 
-	White card
-	Current driver’s license.

Required/Relevant Skills & Knowledge:

-	Demonstrated ability to write, edit, and optimise CNC programs (G-code/M-code or conversational) at the machine control panel.
-	High proficiency in traditional manual turning, milling, drilling, and surface grinding techniques.
-	Advanced skill in using precision measuring instruments (micrometers, height gauges, dial indicators, calipers) to hold tight tolerances.
-	Sound understanding of metal properties (specifically structural and architectural steel grades), insert selection, speeds, feeds, and coolant applications.
-	Strong spatial awareness and ability to convert complex 2D/3D engineering drawings into finished physical components.
-	Strong diagnostic skills for troubleshooting machining chatter, tool wear, and alignment issues.
-	Pride in producing clean, accurate, and repeatable craftsmanship suited for premium architectural applications.

If you are a motivated, Metal Machinist looking to become a critical part of our leading steel frame manufacturing business, please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your machinery experience, CNC programming capabilities, and alignment with our team values via the application link.

Annual salary will be between $75,000.00 to $85,000.00 (plus superannuation) depending on level of experience.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

## Chief Information Officer
## Position Overview
We are looking for a visionary and commercially astute Chief Information Officer (CIO) to lead our organisation's information and communications technology strategy, operations, and governance. This is a senior executive role suited to an experienced technology leader who thrives at the intersection of business strategy and digital innovation. The successful candidate will be responsible for aligning ICT capabilities with organisational priorities, driving transformation, and ensuring the long-term integrity and security of our technology infrastructure.
## Key Responsibilities
- Analyse organisational information needs and define technology solutions that effectively support business objectives and operational performance
- Formulate, implement, and continuously refine ICT strategies, policies, and plans that align with the organisation's broader mission and priorities
- Lead the selection, procurement, and installation of ICT systems and infrastructure, ensuring solutions are scalable, reliable, and fit for purpose
- Direct ICT operations across the organisation, setting clear priorities between system development, ongoing maintenance, and day-to-day operations
- Oversee the organisation's cybersecurity posture, ensuring robust protections are in place to safeguard data, systems, and digital assets
- Drive digital transformation initiatives that improve organisational efficiency, enhance service delivery, and support innovation
- Develop and manage the ICT budget, ensuring effective allocation of resources and demonstrable return on technology investment
- Build, mentor, and lead high-performing ICT teams, fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and professional development
- Engage and manage relationships with external technology vendors, partners, and service providers to ensure contractual obligations and service standards are met
- Champion the rollout of user training programmes to ensure staff are equipped to effectively adopt and utilise ICT systems and tools
- Provide executive-level reporting and strategic advice to the Board and senior leadership team on technology risks, opportunities, and performance
- Ensure ICT systems and practices remain compliant with relevant legislation, industry standards, and data governance frameworks
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline
- Demonstrated experience in a senior ICT leadership role, with a strong track record of delivering enterprise-wide technology strategy
- Proven ability to align ICT capability with organisational strategy and drive measurable business outcomes
- Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, risk management, and data governance best practices
- Experience managing large-scale ICT budgets, procurement processes, and vendor relationships
- Excellent leadership and people management skills, with the ability to inspire, develop, and retain high-performing teams
- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with a strategic mindset and the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
- Sound knowledge of ICT infrastructure, cloud environments, enterprise systems, and emerging technologies
- High-level communication, negotiation, and stakeholder engagement skills across all levels of an organisation
## Preferred Qualifications
- Postgraduate qualification in Business Administration (MBA), Information Technology, or a related field
- Industry certifications such as ITIL, TOGAF, CISSP, or equivalent
- Experience leading digital transformation programmes within complex or large-scale organisations
- Familiarity with Australian data privacy legislation, including the Privacy Act 1988 and the Australian Privacy Principles
- Prior experience presenting to executive leadership teams or Boards of Directors
## Why Join Us?
- Play a pivotal role in shaping the digital future of a dynamic and growing organisation, with genuine influence at the executive level
- Access to ongoing professional development opportunities, including leadership programmes, industry conferences, and certifications
- Flexible working arrangements that support a healthy work-life balance
- Collaborative and inclusive workplace culture that values innovation, integrity, and continuous improvement
- Competitive remuneration package with performance-based incentives and additional employee benefits
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation

General Manager – Sydney NSW

Kogan People Solutions, recruiters, are working with Southeast Asia’s logistics tech powerhouse—delivering cutting-edge warehouse automation and supply chain solutions to the region’s biggest retailers. With over a decade of success and innovation, they’re expanding into Australia and the wider Asia Pacific market. Now they’re looking for a visionary General Manager to lead the charge.

•	Location: Sydney 2000

•	Tenure: Full-time | Executive Leadership

•	Salary: Generous salary package $175k to $185k plus applicable super per annum

Headquartered in Vietnam, our client has built a reputation for transforming logistics operations with scalable, technology-driven solutions that boost efficiency, reduce costs, and create long-term competitive advantage. Clients include major supermarket chains, distributors, and e-commerce leaders across Southeast Asia—and now, they’re ready to go global.

Responsibilities and deliverables 

As General Manager, you’ll be the architect of our client’s regional growth. This is a hands-on, high-impact leadership role where you’ll:

•	Launch & Scale: Lead market entry strategy and build operations across Australia and the region.

•	Establish Presence: Set up offices, teams, and business units from the ground up.

•	Drive Growth: Identify and secure major clients in retail, wholesale, distribution, and e-commerce.

•	Build a Team: Recruit, mentor, and lead a high-performing local workforce.

•	Deliver Excellence: Oversee implementation of logistics, warehousing, and transportation solutions.

•	Ensure Compliance: You’ll need to be on top of Australian business, tax, and labour regulations

•	Own Relationships: Manage senior client partnerships and enterprise-level engagements.

•	Forge Alliances: Develop strategic partnerships with tech vendors, consultants, and 3PLs.

•	Be the Brand: Represent our client at industry events and forums as a thought leader.

•	Lead Financials: Own P&L, budgeting, KPI tracking, and cost control for the region.

•	Report Globally: Collaborate closely with HQ in Vietnam and report to global leadership.

To be considered, you will need to offer the following skills and attributes:

•	At least 5 years of proven strategic leadership and business expansion experience in Southeast Asia (and at least 1 or more years professional experience at similar high impact levels)

•	Deep expertise in warehouse automation and logistics technologies (WMS, ERP, TMS, SaaS-based delivery systems)

•	Strong track record in supply chain cost optimization and KPI management across SE Asia.

•	Skilled in stakeholder engagement and cross-cultural communication, especially within Southeast Asian markets

•	Data-driven decision maker with hands-on experience using tools like Power BI and ERP/WMS platforms

•	Be a native (or highly competent) Vietnamese speaker with fluent English skills (written and spoken)

•	Hold a bachelor’s degree or higher in Business, Logistics, Supply Chain, or related field

•	Certified in Leadership Development, Logistics Management, and trained in International Supply Chain Operations

•	Commercially savvy with strong client relationship skills

•	Comfortable building from scratch and leading cross-functional teams

•	Strategic thinker with hands-on execution capability

Applications

Please respond to the recruiters using the facilities on this site, and ensure you attach your updated CV.

Kogan People Solutions are grateful for all applications, but kindly note that they will only respond to shortlisted applicants.

Job position 

Recruitment Consultant

Role Summary

This is a full 360 Recruitment Consultant role, offering the opportunity to develop and manage your own specialist technology recruitment desk within a high-growth sector.
You will be responsible for building long-term relationships with both clients and candidates, managing the full recruitment lifecycle, and developing your own market presence within a specialist technology niche.
Whether you are an experienced recruiter looking to advance your career or someone with an established background in technology recruitment, Pearson Carter offers comprehensive training, genuine career progression opportunities, and a high-performance culture that rewards success.

Responsibilities
Candidate Management & Delivery
•	Source and engage high-quality technology professionals through our CRM, ATS, LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, referrals, networking, and market mapping activities.
•	Build and maintain a strong network of candidates within your specialist technology market.
•	Conduct candidate qualification calls and interviews to assess technical skills, experience, motivations, and suitability.
•	Manage candidates throughout the recruitment process, providing guidance, preparation, and feedback.
•	Coordinate and secure interviews between candidates and clients.
•	Negotiate and manage offer processes through to successful placement.
Client Management & Business Development
•	Develop and manage relationships with new and existing clients across Australia and the wider APAC region.
•	Conduct business development activities to identify and secure new recruitment partnerships.
•	Generate new client opportunities through networking, referrals, market research, and proactive outreach.
•	Arrange and attend meetings with prospective and existing clients, both virtually and in person.
•	Negotiate terms of business and recruitment agreements.
•	Account manage key client relationships, ensuring a high level of service and delivery.
•	Develop a thorough understanding of client businesses, hiring requirements, and market challenges.
Market Development
•	Build a recognised market presence within your specialist technology niche.
•	Develop strong networks across both candidate and client communities.
•	Stay informed on industry trends, salary benchmarking, competitor activity, and market developments.
•	Create and publish professional recruitment content across LinkedIn and other relevant platforms to strengthen personal and company branding.
•	Contribute to the growth and expansion of Pearson Carter's technology recruitment offering across the APAC region.
Operational Excellence
•	Maintain accurate records within the CRM and Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
•	Manage recruitment processes efficiently, ensuring exceptional candidate and client experiences.
•	Achieve and exceed individual activity, billing, and revenue targets.
•	Collaborate with colleagues across our international offices to share market knowledge and opportunities.
 About you
To be successful in this role, you will ideally have:
•	Previous Recruitment experience within Technology, Software Development, IT, Digital, AI, ERP, Data, Cloud, Cyber Security, or related recruitment markets.
•	Previous Sales, Marketing or Account management experience.
•	Experience building and developing a successful recruitment desk.
•	A strong track record in sales, business development, or a target-driven environment.
•	Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
•	The ability to manage multiple recruitment processes simultaneously.
•	Strong networking, negotiation, and influencing abilities.
•	High levels of self-motivation, resilience, and professionalism.
•	Excellent organisational and time management skills.
•	A collaborative approach and desire to contribute to a growing team environment.

For the candidate 
Full time contract
This is a permanent role so please only apply if you have full working rights in Australia. 
No recruitment agencies please

Annual Salary: $80,000-$90,000 plus superannuation, subject to experiences
COMPANY PROFILE

M10 Truss Pty Ltd is a leading supplier and manufacturer of prefabricated timber roof trusses, wall frames and floor systems servicing residential and commercial construction projects throughout Victoria.

Due to continued business growth, we are seeking an experienced and motivated Building and Engineering Technician to join our team in Melbourne.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

Reporting to the Operations Manager, you will provide technical support across the design, estimating, manufacturing and project coordination functions of the business. The role requires strong knowledge of timber truss and frame construction systems and the ability to interpret engineering and architectural documentation.
RESPONSIBILITIES
•	Interpret architectural, structural and engineering drawings for timber roof truss, wall frame and floor system projects.
•	Prepare and review technical documentation, production information and material specifications.
•	Conduct material take-offs, quantity assessments and project estimates.
•	Assist in the coordination of manufacturing requirements to ensure products are produced in accordance with approved designs and Australian Standards.
•	Liaise with builders, engineers, contractors, suppliers and internal production teams regarding technical requirements and project specifications.
•	Monitor product quality and compliance throughout manufacturing and installation processes.
•	Identify and resolve technical issues relating to structural building components.
•	Assist with project scheduling, workflow planning and production coordination.
•	Maintain accurate project records, technical documentation and compliance reports.
•	Support continuous improvement initiatives relating to quality, efficiency and workplace safety.
ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS
•	Diploma or higher qualification in Building, Engineering, Construction Technology or a related field.
•	Minimum 2 years relevant industry experience in building products, timber truss and frame, construction engineering support, estimating or detailing.
•	Ability to interpret engineering, architectural and construction drawings.
•	Strong technical and analytical skills.
•	Excellent communication and organisational abilities.
•	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and industry software applications.
Highly Desirable
•	Experience using MiTek, Sapphire, Pryda Build, Multinail or similar truss design software.
•	Experience within prefabricated timber truss and frame manufacturing environments.
•	Knowledge of Australian Building Codes and relevant Australian Standards.
CULTURE & BENEFITS
•	Competitive salary package.
•	Long-term career opportunities.
•	Supportive and collaborative working environment.
•	Ongoing professional development and technical training.

APPLICATIONS
